notes: compositions[] fills next: ~43 environment bases (18 concept-faithful + ~15 prop/asset + ~10 experience/POV) + ~12 weapon-detail plates; each gets base prompt + 4 variant -i edits
outcome maths: ~55 bases x (1 base + 4 variants) = ~275 max; minimum accepted 220

prompt assembly per base: f"{subject}, {camera}, {style_block_env}, {layout_binding}" (env) with negative_block; weapons append identity via subject already; variants via codex exec -i edit_instruction

style_block_env: high-desert late-morning light, long soft shadows, game-screenshot realism, 16:9, no text, no watermark
